say:17:1660003008:0.source_cn: 在一场能见度很低的暴风雪中，讨伐魔王的勇者一行迷失了方...

say:29:1660003015:0.text: Mhm. There's magic in the snow... I can feel it.
say:29:1660003015:0.source_cn: 确实，能从暴风雪中感受到魔力呢。

say:30:1660003016:0.text: You done with that magic book, Frieren?
say:30:1660003016:0.source_cn: 芙莉莲，你已经看完那本魔导书了吗？

say:31:1660003017:1.text: Yeah. The whole magic system here is different—the way mana flows here isn't like back home.
say:31:1660003017:1.source_cn: 嗯，这里的魔法，和我的魔法不太一样。不管是魔力的体系，...

say:33:1660003018:1.text: I don't think I can cast these spells the usual way. Even the one I used in the hot springs felt weaker than it should have.
say:33:1660003018:1.source_cn: 所以我觉得，这本书上记载的魔法，用我们世界的方式是施展...

say:34:1660003019:1.text: And this snowstorm... it's got the same kind of magic as that rift we came through.
say:34:1660003019:1.source_cn: ……从这场暴风雪里，我能感觉到和我们穿过时空裂隙时一样...

say:38:1660003021:0.source_cn: 那就多谢啦。一边清除魔物，一边调查这场暴风雪的真相——...

narration:42:1660003023:0.text: Following the clues you gathered, your group heads toward the north hills of Whiteridge, where sightings of Hypofiends have been reported.
narration:42:1660003023:0.source_cn: 顺着线索，你们一行来到了据传有魔物出没的白山北麓。
narration:42:1660003023:0.male: Following the clues you gathered, your group heads toward the north hills of Whiteridge, where sightings of Hypofiends have been reported.
narration:42:1660003023:0.female: Following the clues you gathered, your group heads toward the north hills of Whiteridge, where sightings of Hypofiends have been reported.

narration:43:1660003024:0.text: The higher you climb, the fiercer the storm becomes, and the air grows thick with the scent of magic.
narration:43:1660003024:0.source_cn: 越往山上走去，风雪越发暴烈，魔力的气息也越发浓郁。

say:47:1660003025:0.text: It's freezing... Feels like we're getting closer to the heart of the storm...
say:47:1660003025:0.source_cn: 好冷……不过，感觉我们正在接近暴风雪的中心……

say:48:1660003026:0.text: Even Hypofiends shouldn't be out and about in weather like this...
say:48:1660003026:0.source_cn: 就算是魔物，在这种暴风雪里应该也很难活动——

say:51:1660003027:0.text: As you all turn the bend, a shadow moves through the snow ahead.
say:51:1660003027:0.source_cn: 转过弯，前方突然出现了深色的身影——

say:53:1660003028:1.text: Hypofiend up front! Frieren, watch it!
say:53:1660003028:1.source_cn: 有魔物出现！芙莉莲，小心！

choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 现在不能确定，但我们可以一起调查

choice:35:0:1.text: Feels like someone set this storm in motion.
choice:35:0:1.source_cn: 这场暴风雪很可能是人为引起的
choice:35:0:1.male: Feels like someone set this storm in motion.
choice:35:0:1.female: Feels like someone set this storm in motion.

choice:35:1:2.source_cn: 我也觉得这股魔力很熟悉

choice:26:0:1.text: Nothing, aside from all this snow.
choice:26:0:1.source_cn: 唯一古怪的地方就是这场雪了
choice:26:0:1.male: Nothing, aside from all this snow.
choice:26:0:1.female: Nothing, aside from all this snow.

choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 每次的方法都不太一样……

choice:24:1:2.text: What worked before won't necessarily work for you.
choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 不能参照之前的情况来啊……
choice:24:1:2.male: What worked before won't necessarily work for you.
choice:24:1:2.female: What worked before won't necessarily work for you.

choice:21:0:1.text: Sounds like you've been through a lot.
choice:21:0:1.male: Sounds like you've been through a lot.
choice:21:0:1.female: Sounds like you've been through a lot.

choice:14:0:1.text: Maybe. But start by telling me how you got here.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 嗯……你能先说说来这里的经过吗？
choice:14:0:1.male: Maybe. But start by telling me how you got here.
choice:14:0:1.female: Maybe. But start by telling me how you got here.

choice:14:1:2.text: I need context before I can say anything.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 知道更多细节才能做判断
choice:14:1:2.male: I need context before I can say anything.
choice:14:1:2.female: I need context before I can say anything.

choice:12:0:1.text: I've met others like you before.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 之前也见过其他的异界来客
choice:12:0:1.male: I've met others like you before.
choice:12:0:1.female: I've met others like you before.

choice:12:1:2.text: You weren't trying very hard to hide it.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 你们根本没想过要掩饰这件事吧
choice:12:1:2.male: You weren't trying very hard to hide it.
choice:12:1:2.female: You weren't trying very hard to hide it.

choice:9:0:1.text: You're not from this world, are you?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 你们是从其他世界来的吧
choice:9:0:1.male: You're not from this world, are you?
choice:9:0:1.female: You're not from this world, are you?
